div.h1: Take Your Backups to the Cloud

div.p: Each module connects your Odoo instance to a different cloud storage provider. All are available on the Odoo Apps Store for versions 17, 18 and 19.
The Automated Multi-Cloud Backup module combines all 5 providers in a single install — AWS S3, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive and Nextcloud with independent scheduling per provider.
This free module (Auto Backup to Local / Network Drive) will always remain free and maintained.
